fib: ______ is the verse that describes the activities of the Samaritan in his bid to help the wounded man.
verse in contention
The verse in contention is the verse that describes the activities of the Samaritan in his bid to help the wounded man.
______ is one of the most certain ways of identifying the perfect tense of a verb.
irregular accent
The irregular accent is one of the most certain ways of identifying the perfect tense of a verb.
______ are the forms of verbs that are used to form complex tenses.
Participles
Participles are the forms of verbs that are used to form complex tenses.
______ are used in the Greek language along with abstract nouns though this usage is not found in English language.
Articles
Articles are used in the Greek language along with abstract nouns though this usage is not found in English language.
______ is used to express purpose and probable future condition.
final subjunctive
The final subjunctive is used to express purpose and probable future condition.

perfect tense

aorist passive participle

______ is the nearest to reality of all the potential moods.
subjunctive mood
The subjunctive mood is the nearest to reality of all the potential moods.
